IGUI_BVD_SkidVolume_Tooltip: Volume of the tire-screech sound when a vehicle is sliding.
IGUI_BVD_TowedSkidding_Tooltip: Also play the tire-screech sound for vehicles being towed.
IGUI_BVD_ManualShift_Tooltip: Shift gears manually using the keybinds below.
IGUI_BVD_AutomaticReverse_Tooltip: Engage reverse automatically when the brake key is pressed at a stop.
IGUI_BVD_AnalogThrottle_Tooltip: Enable progressive throttle input instead of full-on / full-off.
IGUI_BVD_JoystickThrottle_Tooltip: Enable progressive throttle input for gamepads / joysticks.
IGUI_BVD_ShiftUp_Tooltip: Key to shift up one gear.
IGUI_BVD_ShiftDown_Tooltip: Key to shift down one gear.
IGUI_BVD_DriftKey_Tooltip: Hold this key while cornering at speed to enter drift mode.
IGUI_BVD_CustomizableSteering_Tooltip: Use the steering response sliders below instead of the default steering feel.
IGUI_BVD_NotProperlyInstalled: Better Vehicle Dynamics is missing its Java component, so driving is vanilla. Either install ZombieBuddy from the Workshop, or copy the 'zombie' folder from the mod's B42.21_Manual_Install folder into your Project Zomboid install folder (see the Workshop page). Then restart the game.
IGUI_BVD_Outdated: Better Vehicle Dynamics: your Java component is out of date. Copy the 'zombie' folder from the mod's newest _Manual_Install folder over your old copy, then restart the game.
